_doc: Ashfall survivors unit atlas v2 (polish pass; v1 kept as *-atlas-v1.*). rect = [x,y,w,h] in the atlas. anchor = draw origin inside the rect: ground point (bottom-centre of the body) for infantry/creatures, rotation pivot (body centre) for vehicles and the turret. Draw the sprite at (unitX - anchor[0], unitY - anchor[1]). facing: E/S/N/W for infantry+creatures (W = E mirrored), heading in degrees for vehicles (0 = east, +90 = south, i.e. clockwise on screen). turret_mount (hull frames) = where the turret pivot goes, relative to the rect. shadow: ellipse the engine draws first, centre relative to the anchor, 30% black; vehicle shadows should be rotated to the heading. Frames carry no baked shadow.

trim_mask.encoding: alpha 255 = team trim; R=G=B: 255 light, 170 base, 85 dark
